Deal [blue]{PerDrowsy}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies for each one removed.

Choose a [gold]Retain[/gold] card in your hand. It costs [blue]0[/blue] this turn.
Gain [blue]{DrowsyPower}[/blue] [gold]Drowsy[/gold].
SPIREDUO-CRUNCHY_SHOOT.title: Crunchy Shoot
SPIREDUO-CRUNCHY_SHOOT.description:
Gain [blue]{BambooPower}[/blue] [gold]Bamboo[/gold].
This turn, your next [gold]Munch[/gold] costs [blue]{CrunchyShootPower}[/blue] less [gold]Bamboo[/gold] (minimum [blue]0[/blue]).
SPIREDUO-HALF_AND_HALF.title: Half-and-Half
SPIREDUO-HALF_AND_HALF.description: You and an ally each gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] and draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card.
SPIREDUO-PAWPRINT_DRAUGHT.title: Pawprint Draught
SPIREDUO-PAWPRINT_DRAUGHT.description: Choose A, S, or P. Set an empty Footprint slot to it. Draw 1 card.
SPIREDUO-MOONMILK_FLASK.title: Moonmilk Flask
SPIREDUO-MOONMILK_FLASK.description: Gain {Block} Block. Lock the left Footprint slot until your next turn.
SPIREDUO-NINTH_SPARK.title: Ninth Spark
SPIREDUO-NINTH_SPARK.description: Choose a basic Line to trigger without changing your Footprints.
SPIREDUO-COIN_RATTLE.title: Coin Rattle
SPIREDUO-COIN_RATTLE.description: Stash 1 card from your hand. Draw 1 card.
SPIREDUO-SUDS_BOTTLE.title: Suds Bottle
SPIREDUO-SUDS_BOTTLE.description: Spend 1 stashed card. Remove all Debuffs. Gain {Block} Block.
SPIREDUO-BLACK_MARKET_RECEIPT.title: Black-Market Receipt
SPIREDUO-BLACK_MARKET_RECEIPT.descriptio: Choose a stashed card. Play it once without paying its Energy. Then Exhaust it.
